name: Gift of Tongues — Learn Any Language on YouTube & Anywhere
description: Already speak a language other than English? Set it as your native language, then pick any language to learn — including English itself — and click any word in YouTube transcripts or on-screen captions (or, with Reading Mode, any article, ebook, or video on the web) to get definitions in your own language and track your vocabulary. Select multiple words to save a phrase, type your own translations, edit highlights, browse everything in a scroll-free grid overview, see a live known/learning/new word ratio badge on transcripts and reading pages, check what percentage of a video's words you already know before you even click it, build & practice your own translated phrases with pronunciation recording in the Build Phrases tool, and import a custom voice from Voicebox to read your saved phrases aloud.
